name: 02906 · Providence, RI
findings: ZIP 02906 (Providence) has 190 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02906 (Providence) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02906 (Providence) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
